_instructions: Merge paths into .paths and schemas into .components.schemas. Apply MODIFY items to existing schemas as field additions (do not remove existing fields). All new request/response bodies are application/json.

Usage._change: ADD three fields to the existing Usage schema. Existing fields (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens) are UNCHANGED.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens served from a cache prefix at the cached rate.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to a cache prefix on first use (full rate).

rate_class.description: Whether the call was billed at synchronous or batch rate.

CostRequest._change: ADD optional pre-flight estimation fields. Existing required fields (agent_id, tenant_id) are UNCHANGED.

mode.description: actual = post-hoc cost of completed work; estimate = pre-flight projection for a planned call or batch.

cache_prefix_ids.description: Cache prefixes the planned call(s) will reference; cached tokens are priced at the cached rate in the estimate.

item_count.description: Number of items when estimating a batch.

post.summary: Submit one typed labor call (sync if small, async otherwise)

402.description: Budget reservation failed (see ExecutorPolicy / pre-flight estimate)

409.description: Idempotency key replay returns the original LaborCallResponse

get.summary: Get a labor call result / status

post.summary: Validate a parsed output against a declared schema
Repair an invalid output using its validation result
Submit N labor calls as one batch

402.description: Pre-flight budget reservation failed for the batch

409.description: Idempotency key replay returns the original LaborBatchResponse

get.summary: Batch status: counts by JobState and cost-so-far
Per-item state and per-item artifact refs

post.summary: Register a reusable, TTL-bounded context prefix

get.summary: Cache prefix TTL, token count, and hit statistics
UI-facing snapshot of a labor job
SSE stream (text/event-stream) or event list for one job

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of JobEvent objects

post.summary: Fork a labor job with overrides

get.summary: Get raw/parsed/validated/repair outputs for a labor job
Get lineage for a labor job

post.summary: Append a job event (REST equivalent of gRPC PublishExecutionEvent)
Create a model-governance policy (which models are allowed for which data classes)

policy_scope_id.description: Opaque consumer policy id; stored and echoed, never interpreted.

data_classification.description: Consumer-supplied classification tag; travels with every produced ArtifactRef.

kind.description: executor = route to a named executor id; auto = let the executor policy choose.

executor_id.description: Required when kind=executor. The registered backend that will serve the call.

content.description: The stable leading context to cache.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the cached prefix. Consumers commonly need both long-lived (order of an hour) and short-lived (order of minutes) prefixes.

role.description: Where the prefix is placed in the rendered call.

labor_call_id.description: Optional client-supplied id; the server generates one if omitted.

stage.description: OPAQUE consumer label for this step. Stored and echoed in lineage; the platform attaches NO behavior to its value.

output_type.description: Opaque consumer-assigned type name for the output artifact.

output_schema.description: Inline JSON Schema OR an ArtifactRef to a stored schema.

messages.description: Optional explicit messages; alternative to template rendering.

cache_prefix_ids.description: ORDERED list of cache prefixes prepended to the call (large stable layer first, smaller per-context layer next).

labor_template_id.description: Which labor template is being executed.

parent_labor_call_id.description: Re-entrancy: the call that produced an input to this one.

output_du_class.description: Consumer-assigned class of the generated output unit. Opaque to the platform.

model_policy_id.description: Governs which models are allowed for this call's data class / tenant / cost / privacy boundary.

data_classification.description: Optional explicit override; otherwise inherited from envelope.data_classification.

cost_center_id.description: Optional override; otherwise inherited from envelope.cost_center_id.

executor_used.description: The executor_id that actually served the call.

custom_id.description: Consumer-supplied correlation id. Returned VERBATIM on every result for this item.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the parsed output.

classification_rules.description: Constrains which executors may serve a call of a given classification.

local_model_required_for.description: Data classes that MUST stay on a local model.
